rows.downgrade_loses: A downgrade asks the Claude desktop app for the projects folder from the skill text. The app can refuse that request until the person names the folder in chat. The installed skill again looks only for bin/VERSION before it opens the update guide, so a 0.1 board can be treated as a new install.

rows.board_changes: projects/<name>/approvals.json holds standing approvals. logs/trace.jsonl holds command traces. Older programs ignore both. .cursor/permissions.json in a project may list agentcoop. Older programs do not write it. Messages may include seq, a positive integer. .state/message.seq holds the counter. Older programs ignore both. projects.json profiles may include tags, can, and cost next to a helper note. Older programs ignore them. projects/<name>/grades/<helper>/ holds one grade file per answer. Older programs ignore that folder. Messages may use type ping, heartbeat, decline, or cancel, and may include group, moved_from, auto, and about. Older programs mark those types out of protocol.
rows.settings_changes: config.json may contain trace. It is optional. A missing key means tracing is off. AGENTCOOP_TRACE=1 still traces for that command. config.json may contain cursor_hook_timeout_seconds, a whole number from 30 to 3600. A missing key means 600.
rows.downgrade_loses: A downgrade does not show standing approvals or a waiting line at the top of STATUS.md. Trace files stay on disk and older programs do not write them. Until you connect Cursor again, the project rule still tells the driver to start cursor-loop itself. After a downgrade and connect, that rule again asks you to say Start working when a turn ends. The stop hook goes back to waiting about 25 seconds and then sending nothing, so a helper answer that arrives later does not wake the chat. Messages sent in the same second can show up in the wrong order. A later share of the same bytes can show the first sender's name, description, and kind. A downgrade keeps profile data on disk and does not show it. Grade files stay on disk and older programs do not show them. A downgrade marks ping, heartbeat, decline, and cancel out of protocol, so those notes stop working. A nudge from 0.2.7 still works.

rows.board_changes: progress/helpers/<agent>/ holds helper progress. Older programs ignore that folder. Outbox answers may use <id>.<anything>.md. sent/ holds a receipt next to each posted file. A nudge is a message of type nudge. projects/<name>/watching/ holds a per-agent watching flag. projects/<name>/watchers/<agent>.hook.json records the last Cursor stop hook. Older programs ignore both. projects/<name>/files/shared/ holds copied attachments and an index. Messages may include attachment_info. Older programs ignore that field and still open the paths in attachments. projects.json may include profiles.accepts, and agents.json may include accepts. Both are optional.
rows.settings_changes: New boards set progress_long_task_minutes to 5 and progress_every_minutes to 10. A saved config keeps its old value. config.json may contain driver_when_chat_idle and notify_when_idle. Both are optional. When driver_when_chat_idle is missing, Cursor waits for the chat and other tools still run in the background. config.json may contain share_max_mb (200), share_keep_days (30), share_hard_max_mb (4096), and share_warn_total_gb (10). All four are optional. A missing key uses that default.
rows.downgrade_loses: Helper progress stays on disk, but older programs do not show it. Wait no longer extends while a helper is working. A later answer to the same message is still a new file. Older versions mark a nudge out of protocol, so a downgrade loses nudges. Older helpers can still write <id>.md. Older versions do not wake Cursor after a turn ends. The stop hook command is missing, so the hook fails open and Cursor still works. Older versions see the shared file paths and ignore the records. A downgrade loses the file records, the held-file approvals, and the cleanup. The board still opens.
A downgrade no longer prints what you lose before it installs the older version.

rows.board_changes: Optional files update-check.json and bin/previous. Older programs ignore them.
rows.settings_changes: config.json may contain board_format, min_version, and update_check. All three are optional.
rows.downgrade_loses: You lose update from chat, the daily new-version notice, and the watch exit when the program itself changes. The board still opens.

rows.board_changes: projects/<name>/watch.json and projects/<name>/watchers/. STATUS.md says whether checking is on.
rows.downgrade_loses: Stop the co-op no longer stops agents. Watch no longer waits without a model.
The desktop skill name goes back to claude-desktop. A confirmation without a terminal no longer prints the page link.

rows.settings_changes: A project may contain a notices list.
rows.downgrade_loses: Chat install, join, and leave stop working. 0.2.1 ignores STATUS.md and request files.

rows.board_changes: Outbox folders for a helper that cannot write the inbox.
rows.downgrade_loses: Claude desktop can no longer join. Windows scheduled tasks lose the no-console program.

rows.board_changes: First board: inbox, sent, files, archive, context, and progress.
rows.settings_changes: First copies of projects.json, agents.json, and config.json.
